final: WITH per_station AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM per_station), ratios AS (SELECT p.observstation, p.n, 1.0 * p.n / t.total_n AS ratio FROM per_station p CROSS JOIN total t), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM ratios), kept AS (SELECT r.n, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.mean_ratio AS diff FROM ratios r CROSS JOIN avg_ratio a WHERE r.ratio > a.mean_ratio) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM kept
